scope: Every one of the 64 result rows in the 28 data/results records at the baseline commit, plus two 16x4 ACE rows lost during the later seed merge.
method: Download all 28 exact-version PDFs and compare SHA-256 with stored PDF provenance.
Read energy tables/text and surrounding method/model descriptions; visually inspect the listed energy pages, including headers, row labels and captions.
Check central decimals and parentheses with the existing Decimal-based validator; retain printed precision and missing uncertainties.
Separate original NQS variational results from comparison numbers, non-neural tensors, projector methods and extrapolations.
limits: This is a source audit, not an independent numerical reproduction or human curator approval.
Unstated spin sectors remain unconfirmed and are flagged in affected result notes and paper issues. Existing benchmark IDs are retained for curator review, not certified by this audit.
An error bar with no explicit convention remains unspecified; no standard-error convention is assumed.
The audit covers the recorded rows and the two overwritten ACE rows. It does not claim that all eligible energies in these papers or all relevant arXiv papers have been collected.
